name: phaseShiftRelation_trans
lines: ⊢ PhaseShiftRelation U V → PhaseShiftRelation V W → PhaseShiftRelation U W
a b c e f g d i j k l m : ℝ
⊢ PhaseShiftRelation (phaseShift a b c * (phaseShift d i j * W * phaseShift k l m) * phaseShift e f g) W
⊢ phaseShift a b c * (phaseShift d i j * W * phaseShift k l m) * phaseShift e f g =
phaseShift (a + d) (b + i) (c + j) * W * phaseShift (e + k) (f + l) (g + m)
⊢ phaseShiftMatrix a b c * (phaseShiftMatrix d i j * ↑W * phaseShiftMatrix k l m) * phaseShiftMatrix e f g =
phaseShiftMatrix (a + d) (b + i) (c + j) * ↑W * phaseShiftMatrix (e + k) (f + l) (g + m)

refine ⟨a + d, b + i, c + j, e + k, f + l, g + m, ?_⟩

rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, phaseShiftMatrix_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, phaseShiftMatrix_mul, add_comm k e,
